title: Pragmatic Discourse Particles: Ugyebár, elvégre, márpedig

sections.title: Natural Conversational Connectors
sections.content: Authentic spoken Hungarian relies on pragmatic particles to manage shared knowledge and emphasis: *ugyebár* (as you know / isn't it so?), *elvégre* (after all), *márpedig* (nevertheless / but the fact remains), and *ugyancsak* (likewise / thoroughly).

items.spanish: Elvégre nem azért tanultunk annyit, hogy most feladjuk.
items.english: After all, we didn't study so much just to give up now.
This is, as we all know, in our shared mutual interest.

items.spanish: Márpedig a szabályokat mindenkinek be kell tartania.
items.english: And yet, rules must be obeyed by everyone.
